visual_identity.core_identity: A tiny ugly flying blood-feeder combining membranous wings with a long needle proboscis and grasping feet.
visual_identity.silhouette: Small airborne body with outspread membrane wings and long straight proboscis projecting forward.
visual_identity.head_features: Small animal-like head dominated by a long needle feeding tube, simple eyes, no humanoid expression.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact flying body with membranous wings, small grasping feet, and narrow abdomen.
visual_identity.limb_structure: One pair of membrane wings and small grasping legs/feet; long proboscis projects from the head.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth membrane wings and sparse body texture.

accuracy_checks: creature is not mistaken for bat

restore compact beastlike body with membranous wings and grasping feet
